Magis Accelsius investor onsite diligence notes (Josh Claman); Series B strategics and exit path discussed — pending approval for base IRR.

industry.structure: Innventure creates operating companies from MNC technologies. Accelsius competes in data-center liquid cooling as GPU power density rises; OEMs (Vertiv and peers) and strategics (thermal/electrical vendors) shape channels.
industry.share_shift: Accelsius is early; Magis notes claim a two-phase lead versus Vertiv, unverified in base model.
industry.trend: AI/HPC thermal load is rising; two-phase cooling may move from optional to required at higher socket watts, but buyer conservatism slows adoption.
